A '''space station''' was located in<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="OuterRimSectors" /> [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].<ref name="TOR" /> By [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Everything Must Go" was released with ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'', it must also take place around that year.</ref> the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was captured by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who began selling off its contents.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to seek out deals on items the pirates had stolen from the captured station.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Everything Must Go" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
